description: Bike Facilities Existing and Programmed - City of Memphis is a dataset listed in Datamidsouth open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by City of Memphis. This dataset provides detailed geospatial information on existing and planned bike facilities within the City of Memphis, other municipalities in Shelby County, and the broader region managed by the Memphis Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO). It includes data on various types of bike infrastructure, such as bike lanes, shared-use paths, and other cycling-related amenities. Coverage: Memphis and the Mid-South. The portal files it under Geography, Transportation. Its keywords are Pedestrian, Bike Lanes. The portal shows 640 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-datamidsouth-org-portal.
